parameters.content:
## 1. Get the invoice
A new email with "invoice" or "Rechnung" in the subject and a PDF attached starts the workflow. The PDF text is pulled out.

## 2. AI reads it
The text is sent to OpenAI, which returns the supplier, PO number, items, quantities, prices and totals as clean JSON (works for English and German).

## 3. Check and report
The invoice is compared with the purchase order in Google Sheets. Every result is logged. If something is wrong, an alert email is sent.
